items.title: Anthropic targets valuation of up to $1.4tn in IPO – report
items.summary: Anthropic is seeking a fully diluted valuation of up to $1.4tn through its initial public offering (IPO), with Nasdaq trading expected to begin on 19 November, Reuters reported. The artificial intelligence (AI) lab and certain existing shareholders plan to raise up to $64.4bn through the sale of 825 million shares at between $70 and $78…
